newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks seen opening lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks seen opening lower.

text.p: Wall Street stocks are expected to open lower on Wednesday as investors sit tight and wait to take their lead from Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan's Humphrey-Hawkins testimony starting at 1500 GMT.
Market players around the world will be focusing on hints from Greenspan regarding the odds on and timing of an interest rate move in 1997.
"Everything today will be coloured by Greenspan's remarks," said Larry Wachtel, analyst at Prudential Securities. "There will be a hesitant tone until he starts speaking."
